description:
At Archive, we believe great products should live many lives. We build the technology that powers branded resale for some of the world’s most loved brands, including lululemon, The North Face, New Balance, Dr. Martens, Peloton and 50+ others. Our platform makes it easy for brands to keep products in circulation and for customers to shop secondhand with confidence.

The secondhand market is growing three times faster than traditional retail and is projected to reach $350B globally by 2028. We help brands turn resale into a real growth engine: a lower-cost way to acquire new customers, a driver of full-price growth, and a channel that can fund itself from the value of returns, excess and trade-ins.

The role

Brands are moving from testing resale to scaling it, and our partners are showing that it brings in new customers and drives full-price sales. We’re hiring a Head of Marketing to move Archive’s story from “a resale program” to “a customer acquisition and full-price growth channel that brands own,” and to put that story in front of executives at the brands we want to work with.

You’ll lead Archive’s repositioning, build a marketing team that works closely with Sales, Brand Growth and Brand Strategy & GTM Operations, and own the programs that create executive-level pipeline: account-based marketing, executive events, thought leadership and research. You’ll sit on the GTM leadership team and partner closely with the CRO, CEO and Product.

What you’ll do

  • Lead the repositioning. Own Archive’s positioning, category story and brand, built around new customer acquisition, full-price growth and margin recovery, and make it persuasive to CMOs and CFOs.

  • Equip Sales and Brand Growth. With product marketing, deliver the messaging, pitch, proof points and persona content our sellers and Brand Growth teams use every day, built on our Command of the Message framework. You’ll partner with our Head of Growth Strategy, who owns the business case model and the proof behind our growth levers, and our Head of Customer Journey & Enablement, who trains and certifies teams on them.

  • Build account-based marketing. Run tiered programs into a focused list of target brands, including insight-led outreach, multi-threaded campaigns to the whole buying group, warm-path and partner plays, and creative executive outreach. Measure them on executive meetings and pipeline.

  • Run events that create pipeline. Own our flagship Resale Summit and an executive event program (dinners, roundtables, and industry conferences such as NRF and Shoptalk) built to create relationships and pipeline.

  • Build thought leadership. Shape the point of view of our CEO and CRO, and run an annual research program built on Archive’s own data, including a flagship “State of Branded Resale” report and surveys of brand executives and consumers.

  • Turn customers into advocates. Run the reference program, case studies, customer advisory board and co-marketing with the brands we serve.

  • Help brands promote their resale programs. Partner with Brand Growth and Growth Strategy on playbooks brands can use to market resale to their own customers.

  • Run marketing on data. Own marketing goals, budget and results, including sourced and influenced pipeline, with a plan focused on what drives revenue. Revenue Operations owns funnel data, lead routing, the HubSpot and Salesforce integration, and attribution reporting; you’ll set what marketing needs from them.

  • Build the team. Hire and lead product marketing, events, content and agency partners, and set the team’s operating rhythm and standards.

  • Bring Product to market. Partner with Product on launches so new capabilities reach brands with clear positioning, documentation and enablement.

Who you’ll work with

  • CRO and CEO: your closest partners on the story, plan and budget.

  • Sales: our Account Executives and BDR, on target accounts, events and pipeline.

  • Brand Growth: references, case studies, co-marketing and helping brands promote their resale programs.

  • Head of Growth Strategy: co-owns our growth story materials, and owns the business case model, lever results and benchmarks behind our proof points.

  • Head of Customer Journey & Enablement: turns your messaging into training and certification for every team, and runs Voice of the Brand, which feeds references and advocacy.

  • Revenue Operations: funnel and pipeline reporting, lead routing, attribution and marketing systems.

  • Product: launches, positioning and documentation for new capabilities.

What you bring

  • 10+ years in B2B marketing, including 5+ years leading marketing teams.

  • Marketing leadership at an enterprise SaaS company that sells complex solutions to large companies, where the C-suite makes the buying decision. Selling to CMOs and CFOs is ideal.

  • Hands-on experience building account-based marketing and executive event programs that create pipeline with C-level buyers.

  • Strong instincts for thought leadership and research, and writing skills to match.

  • You own a number, work closely with Sales and RevOps, and are comfortable in HubSpot and Salesforce.

  • You’re as comfortable setting strategy as you are doing the work yourself.

Bonus points

  • You’ve led or been part of repositioning a company or category, and saw pipeline, win rates or deal size move as a result.

  • Experience marketing to enterprise retail, e-commerce or consumer brands, especially relationships in apparel, footwear or outdoor.

In your first 90 days

  • Finalize Archive’s positioning and messaging with the CRO, CEO, Sales, Brand Growth and Growth Strategy, building on our Command of the Message work, and launch the new pitch and website narrative.

  • Launch the account-based program for our top target brands, including a first executive event series.

  • Set the 12-month marketing plan, budget and pipeline goals, including the research program and the next Resale Summit.

How we’ll measure success

  • Executive meetings and qualified pipeline with target brands

  • Marketing-sourced and influenced pipeline, and win rates on influenced deals

  • Share of voice and engagement with brand executives, and the reach of our research and thought leadership

  • Satisfaction from Sales and Brand Growth with marketing’s tools, content and programs

  • Use of the new messaging in deals, and win rates where it’s used

Compensation

The base salary range for this role is $200,000- 250,000, plus a variable compensation component. Placement in the range reflects experience.

Archive is a Series B company backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners, Energize Capital, and Bain Capital Ventures, and was named Fast Company's #2 Most Innovative Company in Retail in 2024. We're a small team with low egos and high agency, working on a problem that actually matters- and having a lot of fun doing it.

This is a remote role open across the continental US. We have offices in New York and the SF Bay Area, with hybrid options for those nearby.

We consider applicants of all backgrounds. If you are excited about what we're building but don't meet some of the criteria above, please don't let that discourage you from applying. Please note that we are unable to accept applications from candidates outside of the US at this time.
